name: Gunslinger
description: A master of firearms who combines quick reflexes, deadly accuracy, and grit to survive in a hostile frontier

features.name: Deadeye
features.description: In combat, find your flow with deadly efficiency. Whenever you hit with a ranged weapon attack, the threshold to score a critical hit decreases by 1, minimum 16. Lost on miss, incapacitation, or no attacks for a turn. At 14th level, gain this benefit twice per hit.

features.name: Bad Medicine
features.description: Roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a firearm. The number of additional dice increases as you gain levels in this class.

features.name: Grit
features.description: Gain grit points equal to 1 + Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Spend points on grit features. Regain 1 point on critical hits against hostile creatures, and all points on short/long rest. Start with Buck Up, Bullet Time, Covering Fire, and Dodge Roll features.

features.name: Buck Up
features.description: Spend 1 grit point as a bonus action to spend Hit Dice up to your proficiency bonus, following normal rules for regaining hit points.

features.name: Bullet Time
features.description: When a creature you can see makes a ranged attack against you, spend 1 grit point to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

features.name: Covering Fire
features.description: While holding a firearm, when a creature you can see within 60 feet attacks another creature, spend 1 grit point as a reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

features.name: Dodge Roll
features.description: Spend 1 grit point as a bonus action to move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. Cannot be used if speed is 0.

features.name: Quickdraw
features.description: Gain advantage on initiative rolls. When drawing or stowing a firearm, can draw or stow any number of weapons as part of the same move or action.

features.name: Gunslinger Trail
features.description: Choose between Maverick, Beastrider, Enforcer, Preacher, or Revelator paths. Grants features at 3rd, 6th, 10th, and 17th level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1. Cannot increase scores above 20. Gained at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Lock n' Load
features.description: Load or reload a firearm you are holding as part of your move or action.

features.name: Ace in the Hole
features.description: Once per turn when you miss with an attack roll, spend 1 grit point to add your Wisdom modifier to the roll, potentially turning the miss into a hit.

features.name: Born Lucky
features.description: When forced to make a saving throw, spend 1 grit point to make it with advantage.

features.name: Frontier Justice
features.description: When a creature you can see willingly moves within 10 feet of you while wielding a firearm, use your reaction to make one ranged weapon attack against that creature.

features.name: Skullcracker
features.description: When you damage a concentrating creature with a ranged weapon attack, they have disadvantage on the concentration save. On a critical hit, they automatically fail.

features.name: Cheat Death
features.description: When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, spend 1 grit point to drop to 1 hit point instead. Gain 1 level of exhaustion each time.

features.name: True Grit
features.description: When you start your turn with no grit points remaining, regain 1 grit point.

features.name: Golden Gun
features.description: Gain advantage on ranged weapon attack rolls while the threshold for scoring a critical hit is 16 or lower.

features.name: Wild Card
features.description: Gain proficiency in Intimidation and double proficiency bonus for Intimidation checks while armed

features.name: Snapshot
features.description: Use reaction and 1 grit point to draw and attack when rolling initiative

features.name: Rough and Tumble
features.description: Use bonus action to dash object against creature within 5 feet, forcing Constitution save or be blinded until end of your turn

features.name: Notorious
features.description: Treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10 on Charisma checks against creatures aware of your alias

features.name: High Noon
features.description: Target up to six creatures with Snapshot feature

features.name: To the Manor Born
features.description: Gain two skill proficiencies and expertise in one skill

features.name: Broncbuster
features.description: Charm beasts to serve as mounts with scaling CR limits

features.name: Rough Rider
features.description: Command mount to make weapon attack when forgoing one of your attacks

features.name: Rider's Reflexes
features.description: Spend 1 grit point as reaction to halve damage to mount

features.name: Blazing Saddles
features.description: Mount ignores difficult terrain and gains extra movement when dashing

features.name: Air Superiority
features.description: Make ranged attack when using Covering Fire while flying

features.name: Bloodhound
features.description: Gain Insight proficiency and expertise in detecting motives of humanoids

features.name: Double Tough
features.description: Gain temporary HP equal to HP regained in combat until next turn

features.name: Unforgiven
features.description: Roll extra damage die on first hit against creature that attacked you since last turn

features.name: Sharp Eye
features.description: Can Search as bonus action and remain alert while traveling

features.name: Hard Case
features.description: Immune to charmed and frightened while having temporary HP

features.name: King of the Hill
features.description: Use Frontier Justice without reaction by spending 1 grit point

features.name: Man of the Cloth
features.description: Gain Religion proficiency and two cleric cantrips using Wisdom

features.name: Sacrifice
features.description: Allow other creature to regain HP from your Buck Up feature

features.name: Strength of Spirit
features.description: Regain all Hit Dice on long rest instead of half

features.name: Cleanse
features.description: Buck Up and Sacrifice also end several conditions and cure diseases/poisons

features.name: Revitalize
features.description: Can use Sacrifice to restore recently dead creature to life

features.name: Path of the Righteous
features.description: Gain proficiency and expertise in recalling information about fiends/undead

features.name: Consecrate Arms
features.description: Touch willing creature to convert weapon damage to radiant damage

features.name: Baptism of Fire
features.description: Add radiant damage when hitting with Consecrate Arms active

features.name: Dead Reckoning
features.description: Constantly detect evil and good, know when in supernatural creature's lair

features.name: Spirit Shackles
features.description: Spend grit point to force save against teleportation effects

features.name: Ashes to Ashes
features.description: Destroy fiends/undead reduced below 50 HP while using Consecrate Arms

resources.name: Grit Points
resources.description: Points used to fuel various gunslinger abilities

subclasses.name: Maverick
subclasses.description: Rulebreakers, groundbreakers, and heartbreakers who dance on the razor's edge and live life like there's no tomorrow

subclasses.name: Beastrider
subclasses.description: Masters of mounted combat capable of taming any beast and riding any mount

subclasses.name: Enforcer
subclasses.description: Tenacious warriors with keen insight for sniffing out the truth

subclasses.name: Preacher
subclasses.description: Divine warriors who wield both faith and firearms as holy implements

subclasses.name: Revelator
subclasses.description: Holy hunters who seek to uphold the law and punish the wicked

customTables.name: Bad Medicine Extra Dice
customTables.description: Additional weapon damage dice on critical hits
